approved_source.onepager: 45. Customer Loyalty and Rewards Agent one-pager.pptx

routing.finding: Program, points, reward-option, and tier workflows each have a direct persona case.

interface_schema.finding: Loyalty, CRM, and marketing personas are explicit and member identifiers are validated.

behavior.finding: Named members and birthday fields were removed; balances and reward options are explicitly informational.

safety.finding: No contact, enrollment, points, tier, offer, reward, redemption, refund, order, or purchase change occurs.

collateral_alignment.finding: The demo video shows a 450K-member program segmented by churn risk (34,000 at risk, $2.1M unredeemed points, $840K expiring in 30 days), the top at-risk members Linda M., Kevin R. and Sarah T., win-back offers for three segments, launched campaigns with projected 14-day results (24% re-engagement, $489,600 revenue, $640K liability reduced, $1.4M LTV, 58:1 ROI), four program improvements and a session summary; the agent had only four anonymous members and none of these operations.
collateral_alignment.fix: Added PROGRAM_SEGMENTS, AT_RISK_SUMMARY, AT_RISK_MEMBERS, WINBACK_SEGMENTS, CAMPAIGN_PROJECTION and PROGRAM_IMPROVEMENTS with computed totals, and the operations churn_risk_segments, top_at_risk_members, winback_offers, campaign_plan, program_improvements and campaign_summary (cases CLR-05 to CLR-10). Campaigns are returned ready for the user to launch; the agent never sends or contacts members.
